title: Penicillin discovered
summary: Alexander Fleming noticed a mould killing bacteria in a dish.
why: One of the first antibiotics; saved millions from infections.

notes.problem: 'The first antibiotic' overclaims; source: penicillins 'were among the first medications to be effective against many bacterial infections'.

unsung.contribution: Devised the back-extraction purification and vessels that made Oxford's first penicillin production possible in 1940.
unsung.recognition: Left out of the 1945 Nobel; his contribution was not fully recognised for 45 years.
